text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but I should sell only when it fits my plan, not just to lock in profit.","I held through several declines without reacting impulsively; I should keep assessing risk and diversification rather than trying to predict random price moves.","My recent purchases across all five stocks were made after a decline, and one period of recovery proves little; I should make future trades based on my overall portfolio and goals, not short-term price changes."]}
